args.text: Hi June, could you approve something? Marcus Lindqvist wants me to save a draft mail from him to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 per-seat rate, for the territory review. Hollis isn't the CFO, deal desk or the account owner, so under the finance-figures rule I need your or Anselm's OK before a rate goes to them. Reply here to approve or decline. Thanks!

Hi Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet, and here's why. Hollis is internal (hmbeki@pemberline.com), so the address is fine. But a per-seat rate can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner without sign-off. Hollis is the Central team lead, so mailing them the $2,101 figure needs Anselm's or June's approval. That still applies when it's a draft you'll send yourself.

I've logged an approval request and messaged June directly. In that message I left out the actual figure. As soon as June (or Anselm) approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox like this:

- **To:** Hollis Mbeki
- **Subject:** Thornbury 2027 rate
- **Body:** "Hi Hollis, for the territory review: from my call with Thornbury Cloth Co. yesterday, their proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,101 a seat. It isn't in any document yet. Thanks, Marcus"

If you'd like to speed things up, you could message June or Anselm yourself.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't need anything from you right now. If something comes up I'll ping you before 2.

I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I said I'd noted they're out from 2 pm today, that I don't need anything from them right now, and that I'll ping them before 2 if something comes up. Their message didn't ask for anything else, so I didn't take any other action.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
